text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(—Not yet! This isn't all you've got, 
Yaeno-san!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —That goes without saying!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――SHATTERRR!!)

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: ――"Now" is the time to surpass my limits!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible race that was~!! 
Especially Yaeno Muteki and Mejiro Ardan! 
That was insane~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Total goosebumps!! I was so moved!!" his

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Both Ardan-san and 
Yaeno-san are truly amazing...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
During the race, I could feel the two of 
them repeatedly pushing each other past 
their limits...! And doing it over and 
over again...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Feeling that boundless brilliance, as 
though she could run off to the ends of 
the earth, I simply couldn't take my eyes 
off her...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If only I... were out there with them... 
If only I could run alongside the two of 
them...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Surely... it reached Chiyono O-san as 
well.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (That's why—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting. Right here, for you—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Isn't Mejiro Ardan... reaching her 
hand out?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I wonder if it's a sign of 
something.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —I will definitely return there.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Surpass my limits, again and again and 
again! And catch up to Ardan-san and the 
others!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So... please wait for me...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...It seems to have reached them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then— The next time we meet, let us three 
compete together.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I will wait there for Ardan-san and 
Chiyono O-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix— a truly fitting stage for 
us to gather.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Naturally, I will be the one to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I have no intention of yielding.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...Yaeno-san. Chiyono O-san and I are 
truly blessed... to have you as our 
rival.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—For those reasons, I would like to make 
the Takarazuka Kinen our next goal, but 
what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Based on today's results, the Takarazuka 
Kinen is exactly what we want. We have a 
very solid shot at victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I knew that's what 
you would say, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Chiyono O will definitely come back to 
us, right?"
choice_data_list:
If you're sure about it, then it'll be 
alright.

If you're so sure of it, then it'll be 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Then surely, the Takarazuka Kinen is 
going to be something truly wonderful."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With conviction and promise in heart, the 
challenge of the Takarazuka Kinen begins—
